_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4 grid, 30 cards read left to right, top to bottom), read from the image on 2026-11-08. CardID = 17600 + idx; 336 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 36). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [336, 17629]. Her deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's and the Hell's Kitchen heroes': only deck.identity (data/tts/she-hulk.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): SHE-HULK, MELEE, START HEALTH 20, MOVE 2; special ability JUST THROW SOMETHING. No sidekicks (unmatched-memory has an empty sidekick entry, ignored). Every card carries the SHE-HULK band (none ANY): the restriction changes nothing while she has no sidekicks. unmatched-memory spells the hero 'She Hulk'; the card reads SHE-HULK (the overlay `name`).

Lady Justice is a defense card whose printed value is 0 (unmatched-memory has null; the importer refuses a null on anything but a scheme, so `value: 0` is in its sheet entries, like Luke Cage's Skin Like Titanium). Titles, types, boosts, copies (xN) and texts agree with unmatched-memory.
The ability (JUST THROW SOMETHING) is a start-of-turn trigger of the effects file (plugin shehulk:throw), not data here.
